book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第二册
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 3 词表(Vocabulary Focus + Reading A/B 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、慈善主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Many students give part of their pocket money to charity.
words.example_cn: 许多学生把一部分零花钱捐给慈善机构。

words.example_en: She decided to donate her old books to a village school.
words.example_cn: 她决定把旧书捐给一所乡村学校。

words.example_en: The food bank lives on donations from kind people.
words.example_cn: 这家食物银行靠好心人的捐赠维持。

words.example_en: A generous donor paid for the whole charity event.
words.example_cn: 一位慷慨的捐赠者支付了整场慈善活动的费用。

words.example_en: Empathy makes us want to help people who are suffering.
words.example_cn: 同理心使我们愿意帮助正在受苦的人。

words.example_en: It is easier to empathise with others when we recall our own troubles.
words.example_cn: 当我们回想起自己的困难时,就更容易对他人感同身受。

words.example_en: Many families suffer when they lose their homes and have nowhere to go.
words.example_cn: 许多家庭在失去家园、无处可去时备受煎熬。

words.example_en: Volunteers reached out to the sufferers of the flood with food and warm clothes.
words.example_cn: 志愿者给洪灾的受难者送去食物和暖衣。

words.example_en: Giving to those in need is often seen as a moral choice.
words.example_cn: 向有需要的人施以援手常被视为一种道德选择。

words.example_en: Some people think it immoral to ignore a hungry child.
words.example_cn: 有些人认为对一个饥饿的孩子置之不理是不道德的。

words.meaning_cn: 负有责任的;有责任心的
words.example_en: We should still help people, even those partly responsible for their own troubles.
words.example_cn: 即使是对自身困境负有部分责任的人,我们也应当伸出援手。

words.example_en: A sense of justice may affect how willing we are to donate.
words.example_cn: 正义感可能会影响我们捐助的意愿。

words.example_en: The study confirms that empathy has a powerful effect on giving.
words.example_cn: 这项研究证实同理心对捐助有强大的影响。

words.example_en: Kindness has an immense power to connect strangers.
words.example_cn: 善意有把陌生人连结起来的巨大力量。

words.example_en: A small act of kindness can prompt others to give as well.
words.example_cn: 一个小小的善举能促使别人也去给予。

words.example_en: Suffering is universal, so anyone can understand another person's pain.
words.example_cn: 苦难是普遍的,因此每个人都能理解他人的痛苦。

words.example_en: Empathy is one of the main factors that move us to donate.
words.example_cn: 同理心是促使我们捐助的主要因素之一。

words.example_en: He gave his warm coat to a homeless man on a freezing night.
words.example_cn: 在一个寒冷的夜晚,他把暖外套给了一个无家可归的人。

words.example_en: Do not hesitate to help someone who is clearly in need.
words.example_cn: 对明显有需要的人不要犹豫,大胆去帮。

words.example_en: When charity is fun, more people are willing to take part.
words.example_cn: 当慈善变得有趣,更多人就愿意参与。

words.example_en: We should not blame people for every misfortune in their lives.
words.example_cn: 我们不该为别人生活中的每一桩不幸而责怪他们。

words.example_en: What motivates people to give to strangers they will never meet?
words.example_cn: 是什么促使人们去捐助永远不会见面的陌生人?

words.example_en: Empathy and a sense of justice are two important moral characteristics.
words.example_cn: 同理心与正义感是两种重要的道德品质。

words.example_en: The charity supplies needy children with books and warm clothes.
words.example_cn: 这家慈善机构为贫困儿童提供书籍和暖衣。

words.meaning_cn: 联系;理解(他人感受);讲述
words.example_en: Any kind of hardship can help us relate to another person's pain.
words.example_cn: 任何一种艰难都能帮助我们体会到他人的痛苦。

words.example_en: Empathy often determines whether or not we choose to give.
words.example_cn: 同理心常常决定我们是否选择给予。

words.example_en: When people recall their own past mistakes, they often grow kinder.
words.example_cn: 当人们回想起自己过去的错误时,往往会变得更善良。

words.example_en: A single piece of bad luck can make a family slip into hardship.
words.example_cn: 一次厄运就可能让一个家庭陷入困境。

words.example_en: A fierce wind blew in my face as I stood at the window.
words.example_cn: 我站在窗前,狂风扑面而来。

words.meaning_cn: (以某种方式)回应;打招呼;迎接
words.example_en: The old lady greeted every customer with a warm smile.
words.example_cn: 那位老太太用温暖的微笑迎接每一位顾客。

words.example_en: Tired and cold, he used to glare at the supervisor at the window.
words.example_cn: 又累又冷,他过去常对窗口的主管怒目而视。

words.example_en: The supervisor handed me the headset and told me to take the order.
words.example_cn: 主管把耳机递给我,让我去接单。

words.example_en: Cold customers often took out their annoyance on the young worker.
words.example_cn: 受冻的顾客常把恼怒发泄在那个年轻员工身上。

words.example_en: I felt confused when the woman offered to pay for the next car's order.
words.example_cn: 当那位女士提出为后一辆车的订单付钱时,我感到困惑。

words.example_en: I watched his expression change from annoyed to delighted.
words.example_cn: 我看着他的表情从恼怒变成喜悦。

words.example_en: His feelings changed like a succession of photos on a slideshow.
words.example_cn: 他的情绪像幻灯片上一连串的照片一样变化着。

words.example_en: At first the driver looked disturbed to be standing out in the cold.
words.example_cn: 起初那位司机因要站在寒风里而显得心烦意乱。

words.meaning_cn: 随机的;随意的;出人意料的
words.example_en: A random act of kindness can change a stranger's whole day.
words.example_cn: 一个随意的善举能改变陌生人一整天的心情。

words.example_en: He was delighted by the kindness of the stranger ahead of him.
words.example_cn: 他被前面那位陌生人的善意逗得很开心。

words.example_en: He waved kindly at the impatient driver waiting behind him.
words.example_cn: 他友好地向后面那位不耐烦的司机挥了挥手。

words.example_en: The chain of giving humbled every customer at the window that day.
words.example_cn: 那天窗口前的施予之链让每位顾客都心生谦卑。

words.example_en: Customers emptied a handful of change to buy coffee for a stranger.
words.example_cn: 顾客们掏出一把零钱,给陌生人买咖啡。

words.example_en: As they drove off, the customers honked and waved their gratitude.
words.example_cn: 顾客们开车离去时,鸣笛挥手表达感激。

words.example_en: One kind person can change the whole flow of traffic at a window.
words.example_cn: 一个善良的人就能改变窗口前整个车流的走向。

words.example_en: I sat behind the frost-covered glass on that freezing afternoon.
words.example_cn: 在那个寒冷的下午,我坐在结霜的玻璃后面。

words.example_en: The drivers had expected to stay warm on their heated leather seats.
words.example_cn: 司机们本以为能舒服地待在加热的皮座椅上。

words.example_en: Snowflakes gathered on her hair as she stood smiling in the cold.
words.example_cn: 她在寒风中微笑站立,雪花落在她的头发上。

words.example_en: Drivers honked and waved to thank one another for their kindness.
words.example_cn: 司机们鸣笛挥手,感谢彼此的善意。
